automated_conclusions: STRONG BASELINE LIFT: Global Recall@100 (11.0%) heavily outperforms the random expected baseline (2.6%). The candidate generator is extracting meaningful semantic signal.

EXCELLENT HISTORY UTILIZATION: Power users (Tier 2 Recall: 15.2%) perform massively better than light users (Tier 0 Recall: 5.4%). The model successfully translates rich interaction histories into highly relevant slates.

HEALTHY RANKING STRATIFICATION: NDCG scales positively with user tier (Tier 2: 4.55% vs Tier 0: 3.20%). The model not only retrieves the right items for power users but places them higher in the slate.
